verdict_text: Under Epoch's model, C2 is falsified per G3: three checks (T1, T2, T5) are rejected at max-T adjusted p = 0.0053 and the localisation set F has 16 benchmarks (> 10), so the `reframe` branch (adequate with exceptions) is not available. 'Adequate' is impossible (T2 and T5 had no demonstrated power in W3). The W4d refit without F was not run (rule applies only for |F| <= 10).

deletion_test.spec: delete rows of F benchmarks from the residual table for observed data and every null replicate; no refit; unadjusted p
deletion_test.null_sources: 32 from W3 rep/null_*.nc; 148 from W4d refits (runs/W/W4d/null_refit) validated against committed T
deletion_test.reading: T1 and T2 stay extreme after deleting F (p = 1/(R'+1) = 0.0055: no null replicate reaches the observed value), so they are not localised to F. T5 is localised (p = 0.011, just above 0.01; one null replicate exceeds). Even a fully localised set would fail G3 because |F| > 10.

w4d_refit.reason: |F| = 16 > 10: the W4d refit applies only if F is non-empty with at most 10 benchmarks; under G3, |F| > 10 means C2 is falsified.

lower_assurance_interaction: W3 power: T1 0.14 (14 converged), T2 1.00 but only 7 of 20 converged (< 15), T5 0.00 (offset), so neither T2 nor T5 met 'power >= 0.8'. This blocks an Adequate statement and means the non-rejected checks cannot support C2. It does not undercut a rejection: the p-values are calibrated against refitted G-null replicates, so the rejections stand as a type-I-controlled finding. G1 is an interpretation gate (R31); it blocks nothing.
caveats: T5's localisation (p = 0.011) is borderline and rests on one null replicate.

7 of 187 converged null replicates had no usable posterior (2 refit timeouts at 3600 s: 45, 65; 5 refits non-converged by the W3 criterion: 16, 38, 54, 86, 127), leaving 180. The reference stays above 150.
T6 is not a rejected check; its largest components (Mystery Game Puzzles, Furniture Assembly) are in F by the M6 rule.
